- Extra Clean!

- One Owner!

The Platinum trim elevates the F-450SD experience with genuine leather steering wheel, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear seats for year-round comfort. The interior flows seamlessly with power adjustable pedals, memory seat positioning, and an auto-dimming rear-view mirror that adapts to driving conditions. Your cabin becomes a command center with dual front zone automatic climate control and the Rapid-Heat Supplemental Cab Heater ensuring comfort in any season.

Technology integration defines this truck's character. SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition puts control at your command, while the Connected Navigation system provides complimentary 1-year trial access for confident routing. Entertainment reaches new heights through the B&O Unleashed Sound System paired with SiriusXM Radio featuring 360L access, transforming every mile into an enjoyable experience.

Performance meets precision with the legendary Power Stroke 6.7L V8 DI 32V OHV Turbodiesel engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission and full-time 4WD capability. The 14,000 lb Payload Package with Limited Slip and 4.30 Axle Ratio delivers the muscular foundation heavy-duty work demands, while dual rear wheels provide stability when it matters most.

Safety technology surrounds occupants comprehensively. Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and ABS braking work in concert with dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, and overhead protection. The Exterior Parking Camera Rear assists with backing situations, while SYNC 4 911 Assist provides emergency communication when needed.

This local, one-owner trade demonstrates the careful ownership you can expect. The truck has been maintained to reflect its Platinum status, arriving at our lot in excellent condition. The combination of proven durability, genuine capability, and thoughtful luxury appointments makes this F-450SD the intelligent choice for buyers who refuse to compromise on either front.

2026 Ram 3500 Laramie 4x4 | High-Output Cummins | Only 11,404 Miles

If you're searching for a late-model Ram 3500 Cummins near Rochester, MN with serious diesel capability and a premium interior, this 2026 Ram 3500 Laramie 4x4 at Whitewater CDJR in St. Charles deserves a closer look.

Finished in Bright White Clearcoat, this CARFAX One-Owner heavy-duty truck has only 11,404 miles.

430-HP High-Output Cummins

The centerpiece is Ram's 6.7L High-Output Cummins Turbo Diesel, producing an impressive 430 horsepower and 1,075 lb-ft of torque.

For 2026, that diesel is paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, giving this Ram 3500 a powertrain designed for demanding towing, hauling, highway travel, farm use, and heavy-duty work.

Four-wheel drive adds capability when dealing with snow, mud, gravel roads, job sites, and changing Minnesota conditions.

Ready for Serious Towing

This Laramie comes equipped with the 5th-Wheel/Gooseneck Towing Prep Group, Class V receiver hitch, Trailer Sway Control, Trailer Tow Pages, and a Cargo View Camera.

Power-heated folding and telescoping tow mirrors with memory provide additional visibility around larger trailers.

Laramie Level 1 Plus

Inside, the Laramie Level 1 Plus Equipment Group turns this heavy-duty truck into a comfortable daily driver.

Premium equipment includes heated and ventilated leather-trimmed front bucket seats, heated steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, power-adjustable pedals with memory, driver-seat/mirror/pedal memory, dual wireless charging pads, remote start, remote tailgate release, and rain-sensing wipers.

A power sunroof adds an open-air feel rarely associated with a truck this capable.

12-Inch Uconnect 5 Navigation

The 12-inch Uconnect 5 Navigation touchscreen provides GPS navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, SiriusXM 360L, HD Radio, Bluetooth, connected services, and 4G LTE Wi-Fi capability.

The Crew Cab also provides approximately 43.1 inches of rear legroom, giving adult passengers plenty of room on long trips.

Built for Work After the Trailer Comes Off

This truck's usefulness doesn't stop at towing.

A MOPAR spray-in bedliner, MOPAR deployable bed step, LED bed lighting, forward and reverse utility lights, remote tailgate release, chrome wheel-to-wheel side steps, and 115V rear power outlet make it easier to put this Ram to work every day.

The Cold Weather Group adds an engine block heater and winter front grille cover for cold-climate diesel operation.

Advanced Driver Assistance

Technology includes Adaptive Cruise Control, Active Lane Management, Forward Collision Warning Plus, pedestrian detection, Blind Spot Detection, Rear Cross Path Detection, Drowsy Driver Detection, Traffic Sign Recognition, ParkSense front and rear parking sensors, and ParkView backup camera.

Who Is This Ram 3500 Best For?

This truck is built for someone who needs genuine heavy-duty diesel capability but doesn't want a stripped-down work truck.

It's an excellent match for fifth-wheel and gooseneck owners, farmers, contractors, equipment haulers, RV owners, and drivers who regularly tow heavy trailers while still wanting leather, ventilated seats, navigation, a sunroof, modern safety technology, and a comfortable Crew Cab.

Buyers comparing the Ram 3500 with the Ford F-350 Super Duty, Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD, or GMC Sierra 3500HD should pay particular attention to this truck's 430-hp High-Output Cummins, 1,075 lb-ft of torque, 8-speed automatic, 4WD, 5th-wheel/gooseneck prep, Laramie Level 1 Plus equipment, and exceptionally low 11,404 miles.

Available at Whitewater CDJR in St. Charles, Minnesota, serving Rochester, Winona, Lewiston, Eyota, Chatfield, Stewartville, Plainview, Wabasha, La Crosse, and surrounding communities.

Equipment Group 801A Standard brings a thoughtfully equipped baseline that enhances value and readiness, delivering a well-appointed Raptor straight from the showroom.

Wireless SYNC 4 AppLink with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto lets your phone’s navigation, music and messages flow into the truck without cables, keeping the cabin tidy and your focus on driving.

Lane departure prevention actively helps keep the truck centered in its lane, reducing the risk of unintended lane changes and adding confidence on long highway runs.

Front pedestrian impact prevention continuously scans ahead to recognize pedestrians and can intervene when a collision looks likely, taking an extra step to protect vulnerable road users.

Automatic curve slowdown cruise control uses GPS and vehicle data to moderate speed for upcoming bends and grades, easing driver workload and improving comfort on winding routes.

An integrated mobile hotspot keeps passengers connected on the go, so tablets and laptops stay online during long trips without draining personal data plans.

The rear camera gives a clear view behind the truck, making reversing and tight maneuvers easier and safer by revealing obstacles you might not see from the driver’s seat.

Rear collision mitigation monitors the area behind you and prepares the vehicle and occupants if it detects a likely impact, helping to reduce severity and increase protection.

Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go maintains a safe following distance, smoothly handling stop-and-go traffic and easing stress in congested driving conditions.

The head-up display projects critical information onto the windshield so you can check speed and guidance without taking your eyes off the road, improving situational awareness.

Brake assist senses panic braking and delivers maximum available braking force to help shorten stopping distances when every fraction of a second counts.

SYNC 4 AppLink with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps your phone’s directions, messages and media mirrored on the dash without cluttering the cab with cords. *Front pedestrian impact prevention* constantly watches the road ahead and can intervene to reduce the chance of striking a person, adding an extra layer of protection in busy areas. The built-in *mobile hotspot* turns the cabin into a portable Wi Fi zone so crews can stay connected and productive without draining personal data plans while on the move. A *rear camera* gives a clearer view when backing up or hitching, making tight maneuvers easier and helping you avoid obstacles you might not see from the cab. *Lane departure prevention* gently corrects unwanted drifting, helping you stay centered on long hauls and lowering fatigue during highway travel. *Rear collision mitigation* monitors traffic behind the truck and prepares systems and occupants if a rear impact becomes likely, aiming to reduce severity and improve safety outcomes. *Brake assist* senses emergency braking and applies maximum available boost so the truck reacts more decisively when a sudden stop is required. Cruise control with steering wheel controls lets you set and adjust highway speed without removing your hands from the wheel, easing long-distance driving and helping maintain steady fuel use. A responsive *touchscreen* centralizes infotainment and vehicle settings so common tasks are quick and intuitive, reducing distraction and keeping your focus on the road. Full-time *4-wheel drive* supplies traction to all four wheels for confident handling in rain, snow or loose surfaces, improving grip when conditions turn poor. Part-time *4-wheel drive* provides on-demand additional traction for off-pavement or slippery conditions while allowing normal rear-wheel operation when the extra grip isn’t needed. Built to handle heavy loads, routine towing and the day-to-day demands of work life, the 2026 F-150 XL pairs a stout V8 and 10-speed automatic with practical tech and safety features aimed at real-world use. If you need a durable, easy-to-maintain truck that focuses on capability and utility, schedule a test drive to experience its strength, control and intuitive connectivity in person.
